title: Triglycerides

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: A triglycerides test measures the amount of a fat called triglycerides in the blood. The body uses triglycerides for energy and stores extra calories as triglycerides in fat cells.
context: You may need to fast for 9 to 12 hours before the blood draw. High triglycerides usually cause no symptoms, and the test is often done as part of a lipid profile along with cholesterol.
aboveRange: Eating a lot of foods high in fat and sugar and other simple carbohydrates
Not getting enough exercise, or having excess weight
Certain conditions such as diabetes that is not well controlled, thyroid conditions, or kidney or liver conditions
Taking certain medicines, such as water pills and some medicines for other conditions
belowRange: Triglyceride levels that are too low are very uncommon
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
